w: Where miso ramen was born in 1955 — the owner took his cue from miso soup.

dish: clear miso ramen (pork genkotsu and hen broth, 10+ hours)
n: Sapporo Miso Ramen Senmonten Keyaki Susukino Honten (けやき すすきの本店)
w: The miso-only Susukino counter with a permanent queue — an unclouded broth of pork knuckle, stewing hen and vegetables simmered over ten hours.

n: Ramen Shingen Minami 6-jō (らーめん信玄 南6条店)
w: Line-out-the-door miso ramen whose broth is simmered for more than three days into something rounded and gentle.
